summary: This PR adds a single new, well-researched documentation file (ai-os/tasks/sap_mapping/PHASE_0_BASELINE.yaml, 2538 lines, valid YAML) inventorying 213 business-domain tables and 508 API routes across 8 SAP-mapped domains, plus a small ai-os/OS.yaml index entry and an ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml claim-status update; the inventory itself is evidence-based (real file:line citations, cross-checked a stale DATABASE_CATALOG.json snapshot against current schema.ts, honestly documents environment quirks and a false-positive fix) and is purely additive/inventory-only with no schema, code, or .github/workflows changes, matching tier1's additive/low-blast-radius bar. The one real defect found is that this PR's own branch history (commit 7fb4445c) deleted 426 of PROGRESS.md's 438 lines, wiping the accumulated progress history of roughly 10 unrelated prior tasks and replacing it with only this task's section -- this violates an established, repeatedly-reinforced convention in this repo (confirmed via git log: prior commits like 031584cd 'restore prior tasks' progress notes, append this task's section' and bafe07fa 'rebuild PROGRESS.md ... previous round used a stale intermediate snapshot missing task-153107 section' show the norm is cumulative preservation, not replacement). This is a documentation-hygiene defect, not a security or code-correctness issue, and is fully recoverable via git history, so it does not block tier1 approval, but it should be fixed in a fast follow-up commit that restores the prior sections before more parallel-session work compounds on top of the gap.
issues: PROGRESS.md: this PR's branch deleted ~426 lines of prior, unrelated tasks' progress history (dependabot fix, HR/PM gap closures, BoQ hierarchy + interim-billing tax fix, timesheet re-audits, Owner Engine phase audits, etc.) instead of appending its own section, breaking this repo's established 'restore main history + append' convention for this file. Recoverable via git log/show; recommend a follow-up commit restoring the prior sections.
